== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. Both printed faces instruct the player to lose the Utinni Effect after the retrieval. The Japanese lore describes a rugged, dangerous route that allows a quick arrival; the English describes a long, dangerous route that must be traveled quickly. Publication ID 1301_52o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending.
